Sam: morning — heads up I'll need to swap primary for the 08:00–12:00 UTC block on Friday. flight delayed, won't be online for the handoff window :airplane:
Priya: ok — how long of a gap are we looking at?
Sam: looks like ~3 hours where I'm unreachable. primary handoff is at 08:00 my time, but I land around 09:30 and phone might be flaky until 11:00.
Priya: that's not ideal. can you cover the pager until 08:00 and then swap to me for the 08:00–16:00 shift? I can take primary from 08:00 and Luis can shadow as secondary.
Sam: yep I can remain primary until 08:00. after that please take over. I've left a runbook note under the incident docs and pinned the alerts you'll want to watch.
Luis: I can be secondary 08:00–12:00. will shadow the usual endpoints and keep an eye on rate spikes.
Marta: flag: there's a scheduled deploy at 09:15 UTC in staging that could cause noise in metrics. someone should mute noisy alerts during the deploy window if it's not impacting prod.
Priya: good call. @deploy-bot do we have an easy mute for the staging noise?
deploy-bot: mute applied: #staging-metrics-alerts for 30m starting 2024-04-22T09:10:00Z — command by Priya
Sam: thanks. quick checklist for the handoff — I'm pasting the essentials so there's no surprise:
Sam: ```
- auth-service: watch 5xx ratio and auth-db connection errors
- kv-cache eviction: check cache-hit ratio dashboard
- latency: p50/p95 for inference route /v1/generate (high traffic at 09:00 UTC)
- fallback policy: if >=3 infra errors in 5m, flip to backup-region – runbook: /runbooks/primary-fallback.md
- customer-impact tier mapping: P0 = 30%+ customers affected or >200 rps errors
```
Priya: copied. can you drop any quick notes about recent flakey hosts?
Sam: sure — added bullet: Host g12-03 has been flakey on NVMe; avoid for manual troubleshooting, prefer g12-07 and g12-09.
Luis: noted. also will set a watch on autoscaler metrics — last week we saw two small blips when burst queued for >30s.
Priya: I'll take primary at 08:00 and do a quick rollcall with Luis and Marta at 08:05. Sam, ping if anything else before you go. :wave:
Sam: doing a final run-through of open alerts, removing non-actionable paging rules. also started a small prefix-KV cache warm on the canary to avoid cold-start noise.
oncall-bot: reminder: oncall swap requested by Sam. to confirm swap run `/oncall swap Sam Priya 1723660800` — respond with `confirm` to proceed.
Priya: confirm (doing it now).
Sam: I executed the handoff checklist in the runbook and tagged the three dashboards you need. links: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/inference-latency, https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/auth-health, https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/autoscaler-queue
Priya: I'm setting noise filters and will add a short sticky note in the channel with contact hours. also setting my escalation path to include Marta if I'm on a longer plane call.
Marta: ready to be backup. one ask: if there's a cross-region fallback we should notify support-team and enable the customer-facing status page message if mitigation takes >15m.
Priya: agreed. Luis — you good to run the quick failover drill if we see >5% error rate sustained for 10m?
Luis: yes, familiar with the drill. will follow runbook steps 1–4 and keep the channel updated.
Sam: ok I'm going offline in 20m to start travel. all set on my end. thanks for covering. :thumbsup:
Priya: appreciate it. I'll paste the final swap confirmation once /oncall completes.
noncall-bot: oncall swap complete: Sam -> Priya at 1723660800.
Priya: swap confirmed. handoff done. leaving this thread pinned for visibility.
Marta: thanks everyone — I'll push a short note to support if needed.
Priya: quick follow-up: updated runbook with the staging deploy noise mitigation step and added the autoscaler dashboard panel to the handoff checklist.
Sam: perfect. safe travels.
Priya: closing loop — primary is Priya (08:00–16:00 UTC), secondary Luis (08:00–12:00), fallback Marta. incident escalation path and runbook links in pinned message.
